# Hank Berger

> Personal portfolio of Hank Berger, a developer and motion designer. The site
> itself is an interactive WebGL experience: a school of dithered 3D fish
> (Three.js) that follows the pointer, with the portfolio content revealed by a
> "Get Started" button. This file summarizes that content for agents that do
> not execute JavaScript.

Hank Berger is a design engineer building interactive experiences — animating
3D models and designing interfaces that feel good to use.

## Employment

- Software Developer at Epic Systems, working on MyChart Bedside:
  patient-facing healthcare applications that help people manage their
  hospital stay and recovery journey.

## Skills

- Web: React, Three.js, WebGL, Node.js
- Mobile: React Native, iOS, Android
- Animation: Motion design, Shaders, 3D
- 3D art tools: Houdini, Unreal Engine, Blender

## Projects

- [2022 Portfolio](https://portfolio2022.hanksberger.workers.dev/): previous
  portfolio site for showing off coding and art
- [Motion Planning](https://hankberger.github.io/PathPlanningThreeJS/): agents
  navigating dynamic obstacles in real-time 3D
- [Gaussian Splatting](https://assets.h4nk.com/splatapp.mp4): mobile app for
  capturing 3D scenes from your phone
